{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for internal test orders
internal_test_mask = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
df_filtered = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & ~internal_test_mask]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = df_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Confirm premises were met
internal_test_count = internal_test_mask.sum()
print(f'Internal test orders found: {internal_test_count}')
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue}')"}
